caption:
Stop losing your best AI prompts in saved posts and forgotten notes. 👀

There’s a free, open-source AI prompt library called prompts.chat that brings thousands of community prompts, ready-made AI skills, and complete workflows into one place.

If you use AI for content creation, writing, coding, design, or research, this gives you a starting point without having to build every prompt from scratch.

Here’s what you can explore inside 👇

✍️ Writing prompts for captions, articles, brainstorming, and refining your ideas.
💻 Coding prompts to help with development, debugging, and technical tasks.
🎨 Image and video prompts to explore concepts and creative directions.
🔎 Research prompts to organize questions, explore topics, and structure findings.
⚙️ AI skills and workflows for tasks that need more than a single instruction.

But the feature that makes this especially useful is the MCP connection.

You can connect the library to tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, so your AI agent can search for relevant prompts while you work.

Think of MCP as the connection that lets your AI tool access the library. Instead of interrupting your workflow to hunt down a prompt, you can ask your agent to find one for the task in front of you.

Find a useful starting point, add your context, and adapt it to the result you actually want. Your audience, tone, examples, and instructions still make the difference.

For creators, that could mean going from a rough content idea to a structured script. For developers, it could mean finding a prompt that helps break down a coding problem.

📌 Save this for your next AI project, and share it with someone who keeps collecting prompts but can never find them again.

Comment “PROMPT” and I’ll send you the library + the complete setup. 💬
